title: Rehab ROM Measurement ROM Degrees Leaderboard
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rehab:rom rom_degrees=*
| stats sum(rom_degrees) as total_value, avg(rom_degrees) as avg_value by joint_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks joint values by total and average rom degrees across rehab range-of-motion events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rom_degrees` values for each rehab range-of-motion event and review total and average rom degrees by joint.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rom degrees.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which joint shows the biggest rom degrees numbers in your rehab range-of-motion data.
